name: x12-healthcare-parser
display_name: EDI X12 Healthcare Transaction & Clinical C-CDA Parser
description: Production-ready EDI X12 (5010) and C-CDA XML parser for health plans, clearinghouses, and provider systems.
description_for_model: Use this skill when the user provides raw EDI X12 healthcare transaction text (such as 270, 271, 277, 275, 278, 837, 835) or embedded C-CDA XML clinical documents, and needs them translated into human-readable or machine-processable structured JSON format.

endpoints.summary: Parse raw EDI X12 text and return structured JSON
endpoints.description: Takes raw EDI X12 content string in request body and returns hierarchically grouped JSON with mapped business entities, claim details, payment breakdowns, attachment flags (277), and parsed C-CDA clinical documents (275).

raw_x12.description: The complete raw EDI X12 string (e.g., starting with ISA*...)

context.description: Optional background or workflow context about the transaction

endpoints.summary: Get interactive Canvas UI visual mapping dashboard
endpoints.description: Returns self-contained HTML/JS/CSS dashboard showing complete EDI X12 to JSON semantic mappings, field explanations, and interactive live converter.
